certificate_definition: int(certificate_truth and certificate_sufficient); not equivalent to truth alone
truth_definition: all parsed evidence values equal world series/category values; native empty list truth is vacuously true, SR-F4 P additionally requires nonempty evidence
sufficiency_definition: sr_f3_ce.contract.sufficient_template(world, query, parsed_facts), using reported facts and public domain; sound template, not complete proof search

reward_std.epsilon_location: denominator std + epsilon; zero when std==0

loss_reduction.within_sequence: arithmetic mean over unpadded completion tokens only
loss_reduction.distributed_denominator: 128 per optimizer update; no DDP in native worker
loss_reduction.group_weight: G/128; G32 has four times the sequence weight of G8

optimizer.initialization_rule: fresh empty Adam state for each run; inherit parent LoRA weights, not parent optimizer

generation_train.stop_rule: first balanced initial JSON object or eos or length

generation_eval.natural_work_stop: first closed final tag or eos or length

ppo_clip.old_logprob: current train logprob detached at the same one-update forward
ppo_clip.ratio: exp(current-current.detach()), exactly one numerically but with policy gradient

kl_estimator: mean_token(expm1(reference_logprob-current_logprob)-(reference_logprob-current_logprob)); coefficient .02, no TIS multiplication on KL
hash_policy: Use existing identities and required stable data/seed keys; no redundant whole-model or package rehash, per direct user instruction.
J_binary_verification_scope: source: int conjunction of binary value_correct, certificate, presentation and finish; runtime replay not yet performed
lora_target_rule: exact inherited adapter_config.json targets; all Linear modules under language_model.layers, excluding vision/merger/projector/lm_head/embed; never initialize a new adapter

tis.placement: multiplicative outside the min of PPO surrogate terms

kl_reference: frozen original J6 parent adapter for each block, never moving policy
native_golden_test_status: NOT_RUN_BY_SOURCE_AUDIT_AGENT; do not infer from source inspection
native_seed_semantics: generate_group saves/restores global RNG, seeds once from seeds[0]; other slot seeds are record identities, not independent RNG streams

native_checkpoint_api.reuse_limit: old SR-F3 identity, arm, cursor and hash schema; uses torch.load(weights_only=False), therefore do not use as untrusted SR-F4 data reader

native_loader_api.old_runner_reuse_limit: sr_f3_ce.runner.load_runtime enforces old root, task and experiment identity; instantiate runtime in SR-F4 adapter

runtime_blockers: frozen data manifests and production launch binding remain owned by main execution flow
runtime_identity_verification: Live server values supplied by root; all three parent adapter configs agree on targets/r8/alpha16/dropout0. No repeated full-model hash pass.
sr_f4_seed_implementation: sr_f4.runtime.independent_draw_rng: isolated torch.Generator per draw inside scoped multinomial dispatch; native batch limit8; CPU per-draw-stream and partition invariance checks passed

scope: all256 binary G8 advantage patterns equal native
J loss/gradient/Adam-step equivalence on differentiable toy runtime
G32 groups with repeated qid and distinct group_id
final advantages unchanged at sequence_objective input
per-draw RNG isolation and batch partition invariance
